'''Tub''' was a member of the [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] that colonized the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]], and a close friend of [[Wag Too/Legends|Wag Too]].

==Biography==
When first encountering the hostile [[Amani/Legends|Amanin]] after the Lurmen [[Ol' boat|colony ship]] had landed on Maridun, Tub assisted [[Tee Watt Kaa/Legends|Tee Watt Kaa]] in carrying out gifts to show their benevolent nature, to no avail. He managed to mimick the characteristic roll of the Amanin and escaped to the safety of the ship.<ref name=":0">''[[The Clone Wars: Neighbors]]''</ref>

Tub was one of the colonists who survived the initial period of surviving on the planet, after blasting off in their escape pod<ref name=":0" /> and finding materials to build habitats, and lived in the Lurmen village for some time.<ref name="JC">{{TCW|Jedi Crash}}</ref>

Possessing the talent of a scout,<ref name="TS">{{DB|character|tub|Tub, Scout}}</ref> Tub was secretly sent by Too to track [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], and [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commanders]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] and [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] after they were cast away by Kaa, the village elder, and make sure they escaped the planet.<ref name=":1">{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}}</ref>

Witnessing the destruction of the new [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] weapon, Tub sent his pet [[Carrier butterfly/Legends|carrier butterfly]] to warn the village of the impending danger. Later, during [[Defense of Maridun/Legends|the battle]], Tub was one of the Lurmen that rose up and fought against the invaders, and ultimately survived the battle.<ref name=":1" />
